notes.title: Dungeon Exiles 0.4.4a (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is a quick hotfix to fix some bugs and a few quick balance changes.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

A bug has been fixed with the Growing Darkness event that would block the player from progressing if they selected the "Face the Darkness" option.

[b]Balance Changes[/b]

There are more comprehensive balance changes to come, but I've noticed glass cannon builds (mainly Berserker) have been overperforming, so I'm doing a small nerf to Berserker, but also buffing some of the defensive options to make them more appealing.

[b]Ability Nerfs[/b]

Guardbreak damage scaling has been reduced from 65% to 60%
Precision's mana reservation has been increased from 15% to 20%

[b]Ability Buffs[/b]

Steelskin's shield amount has been increased from 7.5% of Maximum Health to 10%
Enduring Cry's health regeneration per second has been increased from 1% to 1.2%
Determination now grants an additional +10 to Armour while active

[b]Passive Nerfs[/b]

Berserker's increased damage has been reduced from 25% to 22%
Frenzy's increased attack speed has been reduced from 24% to 22%
Furious Strike's increased damage has been reduced from 14% to 12%

[b]Passive Buffs[/b]

Endless Endurance's health regeneration per second has been increased from 0.4% to 0.5%

[b]Closing Words[/b]

There are going to be more comprehensive balance changes at a later date, especially when it comes to tuning enemy damage and ensuring that all build paths feel equally viable, but this is just a small change for now!

To ensure you are playing on the correct version, ensure the main menu reads “0.4.4a”. You may have to update, verify your game files or re-install your game.

Cheers,
Gronkins

notes.title: Dungeon Exiles 0.4.2a (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Gronkins here with the first Steam update for the Dungeon Exiles Demo!

So, this is a quick one because I was getting some immediate feedback about the difficulty of some of the enemies, mainly The Grave Warden (who is the second boss of the game) being harder than intended.

There's going to be a more comprehensive balance change with next week's update, however, I'm going to make some quick changes now so people can experience the demo.

Balance Changes:
The Grave Warden's Attack Damage has been reduced by roughly 25% and has had his health reduced by roughly 10%.
The Blight Caller's Spreading Plague now deals roughly 10% less damage and has had the scaling of the Spreading Plague buff reduced by roughly 20%. The Blight Caller's Health and Attack Damage have been reduced by roughly 10%.
The Necromancer's Shadowbolt now deals roughly 15% less damage.
The Blighted Monstrosity's Plague Cloud now deals roughly 10% less damage.

To get the new patch you may have to update or re-install your game. To ensure you're playing on the newest version, ensure the main menu reads "0.4.2a" instead of just "0.4.2"

Cheers,
Gronkins
